data.title: Flood Warning for Condamine River downstream of Oakey Creek to Cotswold
data.message:
IDQ20829

Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Initial Minor Flood Warning for the Lower Condamine River

Issued at 2:29 pm AEST on Tuesday 27 October 2026

Flood Warning Number: 1

MINOR FLOODING POSSIBLE AT LOUDOUN BRIDGE FROM THURSDAY MORNING

Rainfall during the last few days in the Upper Condamine River catchment has caused river level rises and areas of minor to major flooding along the Upper Condamine River. Currently the flood peak is around Tummaville along the Upper Condamine River. As this flow moves downstream minor flooding is possible along the Lower Condamine River at Loudoun Bridge.

Condamine River downstream of Oakey Creek to Cotswold:

Minor flooding possible at Condamine River downstream of Oakey Creek to Cotswold.

The Condamine River at Loudoun Bridge is currently at 2.80 m and steady, below the minor flood level. As the upstream flows arrive, the Condamine River at Loudoun Bridge may reach around the minor flood level (6.00 m) Thursday morning. Further rises are likely.

Safety Advice:

  • Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
  • Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
  • Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
  • Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed.
  • For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next Issue:

The next warning will be issued by 04:00 PM AEST on Wednesday 28 October 2026.
